In the Dragon Ball universe, the Hyperbolic Time Chamber (originally known as the Room of Spirit and Time) is a unique pocket dimension managed by Mr. Popo and located at Kami's Lookout. 
Team Four Star Wiki
 +1
⏳ Time & Environment Mechanics
Time Dilation: One day on Earth equals one year inside the chamber. This allows fighters to undergo an entire year of intense training in just 24 hours. 
YouTube
·Kuzos
 +1
Harsh Conditions: The training area features 10x Earth's gravity, the air pressure is a quarter of Earth's thickness, and temperatures rapidly fluctuate between -40°C and 50°C. 
YouTube
·Kuzos
 +1
The Endless Void: Outside the central living quarters—which supply food, beds, and a bath—lies a boundless, blindingly white void. 
Dragon Ball Wiki | Fandom
 +2
📋 The Rules (and how they changed)
Mr. Popo acts as the gatekeeper and instructor of the room's strict guidelines, though many rules were modified over time:
The Occupancy Limit: Originally, Mr. Popo stated that only two people could enter at once. However, during the Buu Saga, Goten, Trunks, Piccolo, and Super Buu were all inside simultaneously. 
Dragon Ball Wiki | Fandom
 +2
The Lifetime Limit: Initially, a person could only use the chamber for a maximum of two days (two years inside) in their lifetime. Staying longer meant the exit door would vanish, trapping you forever. Later in the series, Dende upgraded the chamber to remove this lifetime restriction. 
YouTube
·Kuzos
 +1
The "Vegeta" Rule: Because the entry door serves as the only link between dimensions, destroying it traps the occupants inside. After Vegeta continuously destroyed the chamber during his extreme power-ups in Dragon Ball Super, Mr. Popo officially threatened to completely ban Vegeta if he broke it again.
